text:
Jordan C.: quick heads-up - Orchid Therapeutics flagged a burst for their APAC pilot. they need temporary egress allowance from our SG edge + a short-term per-minute rate bump. can we triage? @Priya S.

Priya S.: thanks - can you share IP ranges, duration, and target qps/rate? also any compliance notes (data residency / contract already signed?)

Jordan C.: IPs: 203.0.113.0/28 and 198.51.100.32/28. target: ~120 rps sustained, occasional spikes to 300 rps. asking for temporary per-minute window increase to 9k/min for 48 hours starting tomorrow 0300 UTC. contract: signed MSA, customer provided IP ownership attest. 

Marta C.: network / infra question - do you want this as an edge egress allow rule + rate override on the APAC route, or a customer-scoped rate exception on their API token? mixing both complicates rollbacks.

Jordan C.: prefer egress allow + route-level rate override (we want region-bound control). we'll keep token-level unchanged.

eng-net-bot: scanned ranges: 203.0.113.0/28, 198.51.100.32/28 - no existing collisions found. automated note: ensure WG/NAT config sync before applying.

Marta C.: ok. sample config I'll apply to the SG-edge-01 cluster (will run in dry-run first):
```
route: /v1/outputs
match: src_ip in ["203.0.113.0/28","198.51.100.32/28"]
region: apac-sg
rate_window: 60s
rate_limit: 9000/min
duration: 48h
on_fail: fallback: region-apac-secondary
```
I'll post the dry-run logs once ready.

Sam R.: security check: customer attested ownership, legal uploaded CPNI doc. we still need to confirm no restricted PII is exfiltrated during pilot. CS to confirm sample payloads or mark as covered in the enablement walkthrough.

Jordan C.: noted - I'll ask Orchid to provide a sanitized sample payload set during the kickoff call.

Priya S.: reusable ask: can we schedule a 30m enablement + renewal check-in during the 48h window? Orchid is trialing regional routing - high potential conversion but they hit instability earlier which is a renewal risk. proposed: tomorrow 0500 UTC. 

Marta C.: SG-edge dry-run ok. plan: apply rule at 0300 UTC, monitor token latency (p95) and error-rate for 2h, then enable rate override at 0400 UTC. will tag @Oncall Bot for escalation window. expect a short rolling config update, no service restart.

Oncall Bot: escalation schedule created: owners=[Marta C., Jordan C.], window=2026-03-22T03:00:00Z-2026-03-24T03:00:00Z, pager=oncall-eng. Add notes in incident channel if error_rate > 1% sustained.

Priya S.: perfect - Jordan pls confirm with customer the 0300/0500 UTC times and attach sample payload before the call.

Jordan C.: confirmed times to Orchid, they accepted. sending sample payloads now. will post when I get them.

Marta C.: applying at 0300 UTC. I'll post the rollout snippet + short checklist once done. :thumbsup:

Sam R.: after rollout, CS please capture any anomalies and attach to the renewal brief - especially if they comment on latency/cost. those will feed into Optimize recommendations.

Jordan C.: will do. thanks everyone.
